name: Seasonal Care Packages
summary: Friendly neighbors remember you each season and mail a little parcel of seasonal goodies to your farm.
logoPrompt: A small brown paper parcel tied with twine, with a sprig of spring blossom, a summer berry, an autumn leaf and a snowflake charm tucked under the string

cover.tagline: A little parcel from town, every season.

description: **Seasonal Care Packages brings a warm letter and a small parcel from a friendly neighbor once every season.**
- Four letters a year, each on day 10 of its season: Evelyn in spring, Gus in summer, Caroline in fall and Marnie in winter.
- Every parcel holds one of three small seasonal surprises, like seeds, forage or a cold treat.
- Fair gifts: no money, and never more than a few hundred gold in value.
- A letter only comes once you have met its sender.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Check your mailbox on day 10 of each season.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher. It only adds letters: no new items, no changes to villagers.
- Each letter arrives once per save.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
